incidents.summary: Following a chemical spill that contaminated nearby groundwater, Victrex Manufacturing Ltd and Veolia were ordered to pay a combined £80,000, with subsequent cleanup and monitoring overseen by the Environment Agency.

sources.title: Thornton companies ordered to pay £80k after chemical spill that could have contaminated River Wyre
sources.quote: Thornton-based Victrex Manufacturing Ltd and Veolia Energy and Utility Services UK must pay a combined £80,000 to Wyre Rivers Trust and Lancashire Wildlife Trust following the chemical spillage in July 2018.

sources.title: Thornton companies ordered to pay £80k after chemical spill that could have contaminated River Wyre
sources.quote: This was cleaned up by specialist contractors, however, several days later contamination was identified in groundwater nearby.

sources.title: Thornton companies ordered to pay £80k after chemical spill that could have contaminated River Wyre
sources.quote: This continued until December 2019 when the Environment Agency groundwater specialists were satisfied that the pollution had been minimised and that an appropriate monitoring process had been put in place.

positives: Victrex's emissions-reduction targets across Scopes 1, 2 and 3 received Science Based Targets initiative validation.
